lines: There are many musical instruments in Africa.
Let's learn about three of them.
The kora is a string instrument.
The body is half a large gourd.
It has a long wooden neck and 21 strings.
Musicians play the strings with their fingers.
The djembe is a percussion instrument.
The body is made of wood.
The top is made of animal skin.
Musicians hit the top with their hands.
The algaita is a wind instrument.
It is made of wood, and it is hollow.
Musicians put their fingers on the holes.
They also blow into a reed at the top.
body.text: There are many musical instruments in Africa. Let's learn about three of them. The kora is a string instrument. The body is half a large gourd. It has a long wooden neck and 21 strings. Musicians play the strings with their fingers. It sounds clear. The djembe is a percussion instrument. The body is made of wood. The top is made of animal skin. Musicians hit the top with their hands. It sounds heavy. The algaita is a wind instrument. It is made of wood, and it is hollow. Musicians put their fingers on the holes. They also blow into a reed at the top. It sounds sharp.
